LanguageData.TeTr.LinkTrapTT: Link this object to another compatible teleportation trap.
LanguageData.TeTr.TeleportTT: Teleport a pawn to the other linked object.
LanguageData.TeTr.TeleportOnlyPlayer: Only player-owned colonists and pets can be teleported.
LanguageData.TeTr.NotLinked: This object is not linked to any other object.
LanguageData.TeTr.LinkedToNone: Linked to: <color=red>None.</color> Without a linked teleportation trap, this will function as a single-use trap and lose its teleportation ability. To preserve its functionality, either link it to another trap or uninstall it.
LanguageData.TeTr.TeleportationModeTT: <color=red>Toggle on to allow teleporting enemies to and from a linked trap, and toggle off to allow only receiving teleported enemies</color>. Enabled + Linked: Teleports enemies to its linked trap and receives from it; both traps are consumed. Disabled + Linked: Only receives teleported enemies; won't trigger on contact; both traps are consumed.Unlinked: Functions as a single-use spike trap with no teleportation.
